description:
Amendment

The purpose of Amendment 0001 is to provide Questions and Answers, provide a cutoff date for submitting Questions and
Answers, and update the line items.
1. See attached Questions and Answers.
2. All Questions must be received no later than 08:00 a.m. CT Wednesday, April 15th, 2026.
3. Update Line Item 0001 to remove "Kubota" and add line items 0007 and 0008 to account for the Trade in Items.
4. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged and in full force and effect.
